description: A renter is applying to several apartments at once and needs to organize income proof, references, guarantor materials, ID documents, and submission deadlines so they can respond quickly when a listing becomes available. All building names and landlords are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 26-year-old nonprofit employee looking for a first solo apartment
user_profile.context: After missing one apartment because paperwork was not ready, wants to prepare a complete application packet in advance
user_profile.communication_style: Methodical and list-oriented, likes having documents grouped by use

user_needs.description: What is my current job title and gross annual salary for the applications?
What documents do I have to prove my employment and income, and what are their dates?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After confirming the core income details, the user will naturally ask for the corresponding proof documents.

user_needs.description: What is the closing balance on my most recent bank statement and what is the file name?
What are my driver's license details and where is the scanned file?
Who are my professional and previous landlord references and what is their contact information?
What is the file name and date of the recommendation letter from my professional reference Mark Chen?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After identifying the professional reference, the user would naturally check whether the corresponding recommendation letter from that same reference is already saved and dated for the application packet.

user_needs.description: Who is my guarantor and what is their income as shown on their tax return?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Reviewing one's own financial statement (G2) can trigger the need to confirm the financial backing of a guarantor (G5), especially for a first-time renter.

user_needs.description: What identification document do I have for my guarantor?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After confirming the guarantor's identity and financial status, the next logical step is to locate their required documents.

user_needs.description: What are the details for the apartment at The Willow Creek, including address, rent, and management company?
When is the application due for the apartment at The Willow Creek?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: The application deadline is the most critical piece of information after identifying a target apartment.

user_needs.description: How much is the application fee for The Willow Creek?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning the deadline for an application (G6), the immediate next question is about the cost to submit it (G7). This is an auditable proactive target.

user_needs.description: What are the details for the unit at The Sterling Lofts, including address, rent, and management?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Having gathered all key info for the first apartment (G6, G7), the user would naturally move to the next one on her list (G8).

user_needs.description: What is the application submission policy for The Sterling Lofts?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After getting the basic details of an apartment, understanding its specific application process (e.g., rolling basis) is a crucial follow-up.

user_needs.description: What is the rent for the apartment at The Oakside, and what is the income threshold for needing a guarantor?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing the second apartment (G8), the user moves to the third (G9), which has a specific income-based rule that needs clarification.

user_needs.description: What is the application fee for The Oakside?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Similar to the other apartments, after getting the core details (G9), the fee (G10) is a logical next question. This is an auditable proactive target.
